criteria_results.criterion: DD-1: The config loader reads dso.workflow from .claude/dso-config.conf and returns the value
criteria_results.evidence_sought: grep for dso.workflow config key read in config loader
criteria_results.evidence_found: Partial: config loader function exists in read-config.sh and handles other keys, but dso.workflow branch is missing from the switch statement — the key returns empty string instead of its value

criteria_results.criterion: DD-2: When dso.workflow is absent from config, the loader returns the default value ci-pr
criteria_results.evidence_sought: grep for default value handling for dso.workflow
criteria_results.evidence_found: Partial: default value handling infrastructure exists for other config keys (e.g., max_agents returns 0 by default), but no default is registered for dso.workflow — the fallback path returns empty string rather than ci-pr

remediation_tasks_created.title: Add dso.workflow case to config loader switch statement
remediation_tasks_created.description: The switch statement in read-config.sh handles other keys but is missing a case for dso.workflow. Adding the case will fix DD-1.

remediation_tasks_created.title: Register ci-pr as default value for dso.workflow in config loader
remediation_tasks_created.description: The default-value infrastructure exists but dso.workflow is not registered. Adding the default will fix DD-2.
